items.title: 加拿大1月10日起实施新货运认证 逾期超限货物将被拦截 - 全球定制网
items.zh_title: 加拿大1月10日起实施新货运认证，逾期超限货物将被拦截
items.zh_oneliner: 加拿大将从1月10日起实施新的货运认证要求，逾期或超限货物可能被拦截，出口加拿大的卖家需提前核对合规要求。
items.en_title: Canada to enforce new freight certification from January 10; overdue or oversized goods may be held
items.en_oneliner: Canada will enforce new freight certification requirements from January 10, and overdue or oversized shipments may be intercepted — sellers shipping to Canada should check compliance in advance.

items.title: What you need to know before choosing a payment gateway
items.zh_title: 选择支付网关前需要了解的事
items.zh_oneliner: 一篇帮卖家选对网店支付网关的指南，讲清挑选时要考虑的关键因素。
items.en_oneliner: A guide to choosing the right payment gateway for your store, covering the key factors to weigh before you decide.

items.title: Your Proof of Delivery Won’t Get Your Inventory Back. Amazon Doesn’t Care That the Pallet Showed Up.
items.zh_title: 签收证明救不回丢件库存，Amazon 只认入库数量
items.zh_oneliner: 承运商的签收证明打不赢 Amazon 丢件索赔，托盘送到不等于入库，每个货件只有一次索赔机会，发货前就要备好证据。
items.en_oneliner: A carrier's proof of delivery won't win an Amazon lost-inbound claim — a delivered pallet isn't the same as received units, and you get only one claim per shipment, so build your evidence before it ships.

items.en_oneliner: A one-page Amazon agency report that ties contribution, a recommendation and clear owners together so clients can decide at a glance.
